mainEntity.name: How long does stucco repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco repair depends on the scope and complexity of the damage. Small, superficial cracks or minor patches can often be completed within a single day. More extensive repairs involving larger sections, multiple layers, or issues like water damage may take several days or even up to a week, accounting for drying and curing times between coats. Weather conditions can also influence the timeline, as stucco needs appropriate temperatures and humidity to cure properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco repair time varies; small repairs may take a day, while extensive damage or multiple layers can take several days to a week, influenced by drying times and weather.
